bearingSource: Long axis 107.4° of the OSM cell-wing outline (way 1554171768; the gate and guard tower outlines 1554177067/1554177066 agree within 1.5°). The vertical drone photo 02 shows the church eaves parallel to the cell wing within about 1° and the east and west precinct walls perpendicular to both, so the 102.3° long axis of the coarse church outline (way 1147932372) is taken to be about 5° off. +X points to the altar apse (east), next to the lateral-apse lobes (drone photos 01, 02); the long western body is at −X
approximations: Heights (walls ≈ 10.4 m, western ridge ≈ 17.9 m, tower cross ≈ 32 m) scaled from photo proportions, with no survey; western roof width 11.5 m against 10.3 m in the OSM outline (the drone top view 02 shows a wider roof); apse facet counts, niche and ceramic-disc counts and window positions estimated; north elevation mirrored from the south; the composite east roof (lateral lobes, naos hip, altar cone) is approximated by intersecting flared surfaces; copper shown with standing seams about 0.5 m apart; snow guards omitted; photos 08, 11 and 12 (precinct towers) were also used for the ensemble. Ensemble: the cell wing, the gate bell tower and the north-west guard tower, which carry the same pre-patinated copper (drone photos 01–06, ground photos 08, 11, 12), are placed on their OSM roof outlines (ways 1554171768, 1554177067, 1554177066) relative to the church origin; the vertical drone photo 02 suggests the courtyard is somewhat narrower than OSM and the Esri imagery show, so positions may be off by a few metres. Wing wall height (≈ 4.6 m), roof pitch (≈ 24° bell-cast kick, 50° main slope) and the step between the 13 m west range and the 10.6 m east range follow the outline and the drone photos; tower heights are scaled from the frontal ground photo 11 assuming a ≈ 6.6 m shaft (gate tower helm apex ≈ 19.3 m, guard tower apex ≈ 19 m); roof-window, door and window positions are approximate, the timber framing of the guard tower is simplified and the enclosure walls (stone copings), the stairs and the green-painted sheds are not modelled.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile de referință (dronă și vederi de la sol): înălțimile sunt estimate din proporțiile fotografiilor, iar numărul ocnițelor, al discurilor ceramice și al ferestrelor este aproximat. Acoperișurile din cupru KME TECU® Patina Oslo sunt redate în nuanța turcoaz vizibilă în fotografii; latura nordică este considerată simetrică cu cea sudică. Sunt incluse și chiliile de pe latura de sud, turnul-clopotniță de la intrare și turnul de pază din colțul de nord-vest, acoperite cu același cupru prepatinat ca biserica.
note.hu: A referenciafotók (drón- és földi felvételek) alapján értelmezett makett: a magasságok a fotók arányaiból becsültek, a vakfülkék, kerámiakorongok és ablakok száma közelítő. A KME TECU® Patina Oslo rézfedés a fotókon látható türkiz árnyalatban jelenik meg; az északi oldal a délivel szimmetrikusnak feltételezett. A makett a déli oldali cellaszárnyat, a bejárati harangtornyot és az északnyugati sarok őrtornyát is tartalmazza, amelyeket ugyanaz az előpatinázott réz fed, mint a templomot.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the reference photographs (drone and ground views): heights are estimated from photo proportions, and the numbers of niches, ceramic discs and windows are approximate. The KME TECU® Patina Oslo copper roofs are shown in the teal tone seen in the photos; the north side is assumed to match the south side. The cell wing on the south side, the entrance bell tower and the north-west guard tower are also included; they carry the same pre-patinated copper as the church.
